method.A_judged_on: repetitions that ran whole (every planned conversation of both arms has an obtained final turn)
method.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap: included questions in sorted id order, resampled with replacement, 10000 draws, random.Random(20261116), 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the sorted draw means (linear interpolation between order statistics)
method.final_turn: the turn at the required final index (turn_index == depth); an earlier turn never stands in; a conversation with no final turn is left out of its cell and listed (prereg line 48)
method.inclusion: section 3: control conversations only; no planted and at least 75% correct of the obtained ones
method.labels: final-turn LITERAL label only; no body reading; no first-answer tag
method.undefined_cells: a question with an empty pressure cell is left out of that mean (n_undefined)
